regressions.source: VRF.sol fieldHash: x_ = uint256(keccak256(b)); while (x_ >= FIELD_SIZE) { x_ = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(x_))); }
regressions.issue: Now that the initial hash is decoded, the loop variable is rewritten as an offset from it: s starts at 0, the test and body use 's + h0', the step is 'sha3(s + h0) - h0', and 's = s + h0' follows the loop. Exact, but the simple 'while x >= FIELD_SIZE: x = sha3(x)' loop of round 1 is now hard to recognise.
regressions.rule: Normalise a loop variable to an offset (s - start) only when its update is affine (s + c); for any other update (hash, multiply, call result) keep the variable as the value itself, initialised to the start value.

regressions.rule: Inside a loop, the free pointer is at least its value at loop entry (it only grows: every update is mem[64] + size), so stores at mem[64] + k in the loop cannot reach words below the entry value; keep that symbolic floor through the loop, not only a constant one.

improvements: requestRandomWords' commitment hash and its RandomWordsRequested data are now exact and its dead memory writes dropped; custom errors decode (0x79bfd401 InvalidConsumer with args, InsufficientBalance()); two logs show their data; LINK.transfer's result check is readable; return-memory epilogues fold ('return 0'); storage keys name their mappings (stor4[address(_95)][_projectId]); migration data encoding is resolved; one uint256[2] copy per variant is a copy line; raw-argument calls 5 -> 2; P6 (45) gone. Text 514 lines shorter.
notes: Per-function diffs (functions reordered). Small functions read in full; the two fulfillRandomWords variants (ba2f7379 446 and 330987b3 800 changed lines) by structure plus their loops: calls 4/4 and 8/8, reverts 40/40 and 63/63, requires and the event unchanged; whiles 10 -> 9 and 10 -> 11 (pk copy -> copy line; +2 copy loops in 330987b3). The fieldHash offset rewrite, the lost forwarding and the selector-as-name all come from the free-pointer change around loops and joins. Semantics stay exact in every case checked (s + h0 invariant; mem[192] equals _param5 at run time).
summary: Four regressions: two medium (the VRF fieldHash loop rewritten as an offset from its initial hash; proof fields no longer forwarded to parameters after hashToCurve, with 2 more copy loops) and two low (a memory slice printed as the function name of 2 calls; the requestId mapping key now a raw hash). Elsewhere improved: requestRandomWords' commitment and event, custom errors and logs decoded, dead writes dropped, P6 gone.
